rows.verdict_le10: There’s also a surprising amount of humor to be found in Dillon’s Jack
rows.dek_lead: There’s also a surprising amount of humor to be found in Dillon’s Jack, an OCD-ridden serial killer on a voyage to hell. Even for one well versed in von Trier, The House That Jack Built can be a difficult film to unpack.
